column1: # It Takes Two: Hazelight Studios, Unreal Engine 4 (AngelScript gameplay scripts, 5,655 .as files in RomFS), SDK 13.3.5, NVN, Wwise, the SDK's movie module (subsdk0);
# update 1.0.3 (v196608). Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py); played on the Mac to the first level (README.md).
# Engage's 5 GB block, the layout of every game with virtual address memory: the rewriter cuts FMallocBinned3 in any Unreal 4 / 5 main (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py) and gives the 62 GB engine region

# what the alias region has room for (dm/tools/ue_region.py), 4.06 GB here. The Mac reserves the Switch's 64 GB alias region regardless; the provisional 64 GB block gained the Mac nothing and an iPhone cannot reserve it (GitHub issue #2278, docs/reference/memory.md)
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the host writes rhi.SyncInterval 2 -> 1 (found by name, dm/tools/ue_cvar.py); bUseFixedFrameRate is off (no FixedFrameRate write), so the engine
# steps by the time that passed. Checked 2026-11-20 in The Shed: 60.0 fps in gameplay, the same 2 s stick hold covers the same distance at 30 and 60. 120 not measured.
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 in the check boot: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode

# address regions: 2026-11-20, in its first 15 s in nnMain the game's regions reach alias +62.06 GB, within the profile's 64.00 GB alias region (what it takes later in play is not measured here) (rewrite aa7320673719)
